## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-juan polemical pamphlet by [通容](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E5%AE%B9) Fèiyǐn Tōngróng defending the lineage re-attributions in his *Wǔdēng yántǒng* 五燈嚴統 ([KR6q0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0019)) against the Cáodòng-line counter-attacks that the *Yántǒng* had immediately provoked on its 1653 publication. The title — "Resolution of Doubts about the *Wǔdēng yántǒng*" — frames Tōngróng's intervention as clarification rather than retreat.

**Abstract**

Tōngróng works through the disputed lineage attributions one by one, citing earlier sources to justify his decisions in the *Yántǒng*. The principal Cáodòng-side respondents ([為霖](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%82%BA%E9%9C%96) Wèilín et al.) had argued that Tōngróng's reattributions were Línjì-side pseudo-genealogy; Tōngróng counters that he is merely correcting accreted Cáodòng errors. The polemic is unresolvable on its own terms — both sides could and did adduce earlier-source quotations supporting their position — but the *Jiěhuò biān* is essential reading alongside the *Yántǒng* to understand the structure of the controversy.
